pages.title: Psycho Deep Fry
pages.text: In Psycho Deep Fry, the San Diego song in Skitchin', the lead that sounds like a guitar comes from the PSG, the simple square-wave sound chip inside the Genesis. You'll find it on the song's Melody track. San Diego is the third race, 4.6 miles long, and its password is BEACH.

pages.title: Why the lead is on the PSG
pages.text: Composer Jeff van Dyck first wrote the lead guitar as a sample, but it didn't fit with the rest of the band, so he moved it to the PSG chip. Jeff says that beepy lead is what makes the game sound "Genesis."

pages.title: Three samples on one channel
pages.text: The Genesis has only one channel for samples, so most games play one sample at a time. Kevin Pickell wrote EA's sound driver, which mixes three samples on that one channel. That's how a kick drum, a snare and a guitar can all play together.
